decision: Use KMP algorithm for overlapping pattern matching
rationale: str.count() skips overlapping matches. KMP provides O(n+m) overlapping match counting which is efficient for patterns up to 100K chars.

decision: Store prefix/suffix strings of length min(len(F(k)), len(p)-1) at each DP level
rationale: Cross-boundary matches can only start within len(p)-1 characters of the junction. Storing these bounded-length strings keeps memory manageable even for n=100.

decision: Build F(n) directly for small n where the full string fits in memory
rationale: For small n (where len(F(n)) < 2*len(p)), it's simpler and correct to just build the string and count directly. Switch to DP when strings grow beyond this threshold.
